items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 54:1
items.html: (To the question) From the new light that broke through the Parsa and came out through the Tabur, the bottom Hey was brought down from the eyes of Keter, and AVI returned to the Rosh, and came into the state of face to back. And from the light that came out through the Yesod of AK to AVI, MAN was made for AVI, which brought them to the state of face to face, and they brought out the seven Kings of Nekudim. (p. 548, Item 5)
